fields.why: Tables 1 and 2 test coverage across 5 ages, 3 MSA categories and 4 insurance categories, each against a named referent.

MSA status (non-MSA, nonprincipal, principal city) is rurality, insurance is SES, and age has 5 levels. Race/ethnicity and poverty results are only in supplementary tables outside the packet, so leaving them out is defensible.
Table notes give the t-test marks against single referents (age 13 years; MSA principal city; private insurance only), and the text reports percentage-point differences against them.
